items.title: Optimizing Document Lookup: Making Atlas Search and Vector Search Up to 5x Faster
items.summary: Sometimes the biggest performance gains come not from making core operations faster, but from eliminating unnecessary work surrounding them. That is exactly what we discovered while optimizing document lookup in MongoDB Atlas Search and Vector Search. By removing redundant query planning and execution overhead, we made search queries up to 5x faster without changing the underlying search algorithms.

items.title: The $5 Trillion Shift: Preparing Retail Backends for the Age of AI Agents
items.summary: Retail is entering the era of the multi-agent shopping assistant. Instead of a single, stateless chatbot following a rigid script, retailers are building systems where multiple agents collaborate behind the scenes, drawing on preferences and customer purchase history to deliver recommendations that improve with every interaction. More retailers are reconfiguring their backends to reflect the rise in agentic usage, as this is no small trend: McKinsey estimates AI agents could mediate $3 trillion
